titleEn: Take K of Each Character From Left and Right
title: 每种字符至少取 K 个
summary: 每分钟只能从字符串左端或右端取一个字符，求取得至少 k 个 a、b、c 的最少分钟数，不可能返回负一。
insight: 从两端取走的字符等价于保留一个连续中间子串。要让取走数满足要求，保留窗口中每种字符最多为 total[char]-k；找满足上限的最长窗口，答案为 n-windowLength。
pitfalls: 任一字符总数不足 k 时无解
窗口约束是每种字符各自的上限

solutions.title: 最长可保留中间滑窗
solutions.idea: 把最少取字符转化为最大保留子串。
steps: 统计 total[3]，若任一小于 k 返回 -1
右指针扩展窗口并增加 window 计数
若新字符计数超过对应 limit，移动 left 缩窗直到合法
记录最大窗口长度，返回 n-maximum

code.java: class Solution { public int takeCharacters(String s,int k){int[] total=new int[3];for(char character:s.toCharArray())total[character-'a']++;for(int count:total)if(count<k)return -1;int[] window=new int[3];int left=0,maximum=0;for(int right=0;right<s.length();right++){int index=s.charAt(right)-'a';window[index]++;while(window[index]>total[index]-k)window[s.charAt(left++)-'a']--;maximum=Math.max(maximum,right-left+1);}return s.length()-maximum;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun takeCharacters(s:String,k:Int):Int{val total=IntArray(3);for(character in s)total[character-'a']++;if(total.any{it<k})return -1;val window=IntArray(3);var left=0;var maximum=0;for(right in s.indices){val index=s[right]-'a';window[index]++;while(window[index]>total[index]-k)window[s[left++]-'a']--;maximum=maxOf(maximum,right-left+1)};return s.length-maximum} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int takeCharacters(string s,int k){int total[3]={};for(char character:s)++total[character-'a'];for(int count:total)if(count<k)return -1;int window[3]={},left=0,maximum=0;for(int right=0;right<(int)s.size();++right){int index=s[right]-'a';++window[index];while(window[index]>total[index]-k)--window[s[left++]-'a'];maximum=max(maximum,right-left+1);}return s.size()-maximum;} };
